CREATE TABLE simulator_accounts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	cash NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	reserved NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	initial_capital NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	max_order NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	loss_limit NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	realized_pnl NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	halted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	halt_reason VARCHAR(64), 
	mandate JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE simulator_instruments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	exchange VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	multiplier NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	lot NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	tick NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	price NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	fx_to_base NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	as_of TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	protected BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	security_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES simulator_accounts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE simulator_orders (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	instrument_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	limit_price NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	filled NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	fees NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	reserve NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	nonce_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	details_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	approval JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (account_id, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES simulator_accounts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(instrument_id) REFERENCES simulator_instruments (id)
)

CREATE TABLE simulator_positions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	instrument_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	cost_basis NUMERIC(28, 10) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (account_id, instrument_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES simulator_accounts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(instrument_id) REFERENCES simulator_instruments (id)
)

CREATE TABLE execution_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	order_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	event_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (order_id, event_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES simulator_orders (id)
)
